| | | 215 Pleasant Street |

Hybrid participation: In-person at City Hall and online using Teams webinars.

This Transportation Commissions meeting will be held remotely and in-person in accordance with Chapter 2 of the Acts of 2023 and subsequent acts adopted by the General Court and approved by the Governor.

If using remote participation, we recommend that you join this meeting by computer or mobile device. Meeting details can be found below.

For assistance, please send an e-mail to Marcella Cannatti at mcannatti@cityofmalden.org.

1. Roll Call
2. Election of Officers
3. Introductions

headline: Election of officers, overview of commission duties, and requests for bus shelters and a 5k road race.
summary: The commission will elect officers and review its ordinance, responsibilities, and meeting expectations. It will also discuss traffic and parking regulations, a request for Fair Shair bus shelters, help for the Wobble Before You Gobble 5k road race, existing requests from the Traffic Commission, and its ongoing meeting schedule.
